name: Pechka Monica
source:
A third-year general education student at Laikask Academy and the president of the school's drama club.

She has a short temper, so due to the way she acts and talks, every other member of the drama club aside from her has quit. The regret she feels because of this has affected her passion for theater, and even caused her to lose sight of her dream to one day become an actress. She idles away the days in the clubroom by herself, doing nothing.

She stands out a lot due to her rough manner of speaking and dramatic personality, but beneath that, she's a caring person whom you can depend on.

One of her greatest insecurities is her childish appearance, and if you touch upon it, she'll get mad.
